title: Self-Weight
description: body forces / self-weight (자중) - define gravity loads
usage:
Load Case Name

Assign the load case name. Click the ... Button to the right to enter, additional load cases and modify or delete existing load cases.



Load Group Name

Select the desire Load Group that will include the entered Self Weight load data. Select "Defualt", if a Group assignment is unnecessary. Click the ... Button to the right to add, modify or delete Load Groups.



To enter or add new self-weight cases

Enter the following items and click the Add Button:



Self-Weight Factor

X : Self-weight factor in the GCS X-direction

Y : Self-weight factor in the GCS Y-direction

Z : Self-weight factor in the GCS Z-direction



Note 1

If the entered in-plane and out-of-plane thicknesses are different, in-plane thickness is used for calculating the Self weight. However, when in-plane thickness is ?? out-of-plane thickness will be used.



Note 2

For Self weight of Stiffened Plate, the program uses greater of the in-plane thicknesses ?yz section and xz section. However, when in-plane thickness is ?? the greater of out-of-plane thicknesses will be used.



To modify previously entered self-weight cases

Select the relevant case from the self-weight list at the bottom of the dialog box, modify the entry field at the top and click the Modify Button.



To delete previously entered self-weight cases

Select the relevant load case from the self-weight list at the bottom of the dialog box and click the Delete Button.
